text: The first class begins with listening.
A client asks about hair loss, privacy and a maintenance routine.
They record the client's goal, routine, questions, limits and next step.
Then they find and rewrite unsupported promises.
Success means explaining a clear next step without pressure.
This is communication education, not a procedure or a medical diagnosis.
The proposed sixty-minute format gives time to model the conversation, practice, receive feedback and explain the decision.
